public_rationale: Supported under the contextual reading about relying on unverified outputs for consequential decisions. The February safety report identifies continuing material failures and says available mitigations do not meet requirements in many high-stakes settings. This does not support a blanket claim that generative AI has no trustworthy or useful supervised applications.
limitations: The outcome depends on the surrounding high-stakes context.
The evidence is a scientific synthesis, not certification testing of a particular military system.

our_interpretation: In context, the ordinary reading concerns depending on generative AI to avoid serious errors in consequential decisions without human verification.

criteria.support_condition: Relevant evaluations or a credible synthesis establish persistent material errors and insufficient reliability for consequential autonomous use.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative validation establishes dependable performance across the consequential autonomous uses described, with serious errors controlled to applicable safety requirements.
